problem: A loop could be fixed at a point in time yet later lose scheduler/runtime/stage continuity without a canonical continuous proof that the loop remained closed.
root_cause: Powerhouse Assurance v1 primarily proved repository/registry/parity drift and did not maintain per-loop runtime freshness plus explicit end-to-end closure-stage evidence.
change: Added a five-minute Loop Assurance meta-loop over existing runtime truth, scheduler state, eight closure-stage receipts, canonical Brain obligations and CI registration.
evidence: pg_cron job powerhouse-loop-assurance-v2 active every five minutes
first production refresh materialized non-GREEN loops as OPERATIONS_ASSURANCE obligations
Powerhouse Assurance, RLS, Supabase security/preview and quality surface gates validate the new contracts
learning: A loop is not CLOSED_GREEN because it worked once. GREEN is a continuously re-proven state requiring current scheduler/runtime authority plus input, decision, action, readback, outcome, measurement, learning and guard evidence.
prevention: future material loops must register in powerhouse/assurance/loop-registry.json
missing or stale stage evidence is at least AMBER
missing/inactive scheduler or runtime older than 2x cadence is RED
non-GREEN state becomes canonical OPERATIONS_ASSURANCE work instead of a chat-only warning
